quest.title: The Call of Mystical Martial Arts
quest.description: An Adventurer wants to seek out the legendary martial arts of Liyue, yet no sooner had they set foot on the road than they ran into mortal danger...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: Phew... Saved at last... Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: I am called Gesine. As you can see, I am an Adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: #Someone as skilled as you is surely no ordinary person! Are you a well-meaning knight? Or perhaps an errant {M#hero}{F#heroine}, wandering the land?

choices.text: I am but a passing traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's name is Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}, who also happens to be a member of the Adventurers' Guild!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: So you are an adventurer after all, and quite the experienced one at that! You were able to dispose of such powerful monsters so easily... there really always is a bigger fish.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Whereas for me... In training, I can easily remember what to do, but the second I have to do it for real, my body just doesn't listen to me...

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Do I really have to train for another three to five years like my teacher said? But it'll be totally humiliating if I go back empty-handed like this... *sobs*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, it's probably just because we have more experience! It took us a long time and a lot of battles before we got this strong!

choices.text: First, you need to be able to stay calm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Rookies often panic when they get into a real fight, so they tend to perform way worse than they might have otherwise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No matter how strong the enemy looks, you've gotta keep a cool head while you observe them and find their weak point!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then you can take 'em down in a flash with a good ol' one-two, whap, ka-pow!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: I see... Now that's experience talking! It seems I still need to hone my skills as I travel.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you on a journey as well?

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Yes... I'm planning a trip to <color=#00E1FFFF>Liyue</color>.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Have you heard of the martial arts of Liyue? I've heard people can fly from rooftop to rooftop and run up walls, harden their skin so weapons can't pierce them, and even split iron like it was kindling!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: If I could find a master to teach me a thing or two, I bet this whole adventuring thing would be a lot easier for me.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: But to be perfectly honest, though I've been a member of the Adventurers' Guild for quite some time now, this is my first time going on a long trip.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: *sigh* And no sooner had I left the city than I found my way blocked by monsters. Can I really make it to Liyue in one piece...?

choices.text: We're on our way to Liyue too.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Really? Or is it possible someone as experienced as you is also seeking someone of great prowess?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not really! We're just traveling across all the nations of Teyvat for... reasons.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though we don't know Liyue all that well, we were planning on going there sooner or later anyway!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we're heading the same way, we can watch each others' backs!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Wow! I never imagined I'd be able to work with an adventurer as accomplished as yourself... There's hope for my journey after all!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Let me lead the way then. I studied the map carefully before I left, so there's no way I'll get lost!

choices.text: Care to join us?
It's also important to judge the situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! If you can tell the enemy is way above your pay grade, it's better to get out while you still can. Don't try and be a hero!

choices.text: I would prefer not to reveal my identity...

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: I understand! You must be charged with a secret mission, and must be discreet in your dealings...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yep, that's pretty much it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, that's enough with the mysterious act!

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: Sorry! Can you wait here for a moment?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you forget something?

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: No, that I didn't. But looking at the map, if we go any further, we'll have left Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: And there's no way to know when I'll return... When my teacher sees my message, he'll flip his lid...

choices.text: You've mentioned your teacher before...

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Yes... When he first became an Adventurer, he ran into some Mitachurls out in the wild. During the melee, he let his guard down and got knocked out by an axe.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: He was lucky a passing Knight saved him and took him back.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: He was so ashamed, he decided to train his combat skills to the absolute max before he went out again. He's now been training for a decade...

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: He always says the basics are the most important, but I just can't stand hacking away at wooden dummies every day!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: So I went out alone, without telling him...

choices.text: Go back once you're stronger.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Yeah! That's exactly what I was thinking.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Ah, I've got it...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Gesine takes out some Dandelion Seeds from her pack, placing them on her palm. She speaks softly to them, and then releases them to be scattered by the wind...

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: According to our customs, Dandelions can carry wishes.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: I just wished that everything will go smoothly on my journey, that I'll reach my goals, and that my teacher will understand me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I am certain the Anemo Archon has heard your wish.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Yeah! Time to forge ahead!

choices.text: Do something he'd be proud of.
Is he an Adventurer too?

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: That's <color=#00E1FFFF>Dihua Marsh</color> up ahead, right? It's so beautiful! You won't see anything like this in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: I knew that going on a journey was the right decision!

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: Oh, right! This doesn't happen every day, so let's take a picture together as a keepsake!

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: I'll treasure this photo of us together!

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: Ah! I didn't realize how hungry I was until I relaxed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now you mention it, Paimon's tummy is starting to rumble too...

choices.text: Let's find a place to rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's take a look around, find a place we can score some food!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: There don't seem to be any suitable restaurants nearby... Given how much you've helped and how much I look up to you, I'd feel bad eating at just any old place.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Speaking of food, might that building on top of that giant rock up ahead be the famous <color=#00E1FFFF>Wangshu Inn</color>?

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: I heard from a Liyue merchant who does business in Mondstadt that the food there is simply superb!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Let me treat you to a feast as thanks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woo-hoo! Let's go get some food!

choices.text: Paimon, light a fire and start cooking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You can't just order Paimon around like that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, it's not like you don't know what Paimon's cooking is like...

dialogues.speaker: Gesine
dialogues.text: I've heard that Liyue cuisine has a holistic focus on appearance, smell, and taste! It really does look so different.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon's mouth is watering just looking at it!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Together, you savor the delicacies of Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowowow, this is delicious too, and this, and that... Ahhh, I'm too stuffed to eat another bite!

choices.text: Now that was great!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Thank you so much for everything you've done! If it weren't for you, I can't imagine how much more difficult it would've been for me to get here.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: One of the staff here told me that if I stay on this road, <color=#00E1FFFF>Liyue Harbor</color> will be just up ahead.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: I plan to rest here for a few days, and ask around about where I can find legendary experts, then decide where I should go next.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Though I really enjoyed traveling with you, I can't keep imposing on you like this.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Moving forward, it's up to me to get stronger, so that I can become an Adventurer just as reliable as you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, though we didn't spend that much time together, we had a good time too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I hope we'll meet again sometime!

choices.text: May we meet again.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Yeah! You too, I hope your travels go well!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Gesine waves goodbye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since we're here, why don't we take a look around the area?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe there are more exciting encounters awaiting us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gesine said <color=#00E1FFFF>Liyue Harbor</color> was just up ahead. We should go check it out when we have time!

choices.text: I hope you find what you're looking for!
I'm completely recovered from traveling!

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: Still, you must be really busy, for you to take the time to do this for me...

choices.text: Fighting for justice is just part of my daily routine.

response.speaker: Gesine
response.text: In that case, allow me to thank you in advance for putting up with me, for a while at least! I studied the map carefully before setting out, so I'll do my best not to slow you down!

choices.text: Helping the next generation of heroes is part of my job, too.
C'mon, we'll take you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Gesine inquires after the menu with the innkeeper, and orders several dishes as expensive as they are famous...
